note: Ana walks to the bus stop, gets on the bus, gets off at the mall, walks inside, requests and receives juice, thanks the clerk, then takes a taxi home and gets out. This is the earlier 6.4 example, now 6.5 after inserting Going. Use get ON/OFF a bus/train/airplane/boat and get IN/OUT OF a car/taxi. First/then/after that/finally are known, not yellow. Express the destination with I am going to the mall before the action; the unverified purpose-infinitive to go to is not silently introduced. Train/car and later airplane/boat transfers need connected entry–journey–exit examples, not additions inside Ana’s bus–taxi outing.
